**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  [Javaagent] Preserve the unconditional mailbox task exclusion**

On Pekko 1.x with `otel.instrumentation.pekko-actor.enabled=false` but executor instrumentation enabled, this mailbox reset is skipped, whereas the removed `PekkoIgnoredTypesConfigurer` previously excluded mailbox tasks unconditionally through `AgentInstaller.configureIgnoredTypes`. Generic executor instrumentation can now capture the context that schedules `Dispatcher$$anon$1` and keep it current for the entire shared mailbox run. Since per-envelope actor advice is also disabled, unrelated messages drained in that batch can inherit the scheduling request's parent. Retain the mailbox task exclusion independently of actor-module enablement.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  [Testing] Wire the Scala server tests into testNewServerAt**

Only the Java source directory is configured for `testNewServerAt`, and this suite is omitted from the later Scala-source and 1.x-shim lists. Consequently, it reruns only `PekkoHttpServerJavaRouteTest`, which already hardcodes `newServerAt`; the flag is read only by `PekkoHttpTestBinding` in the uncompiled Scala shim. The task therefore passes without exercising the existing sync, async, and connection-source server tests through the alternate 1.x binding paths. Include the shared Scala sources, resources, and `pekko1TestShim` in this suite so the intended variant actually runs.
